verdict_text: NO. The merge computes the second task vector against the already-modified tensor: `tmp = b + λ(f1 - b)` and then `tmp + λ(f2 - tmp)`, so the ft2 delta is taken relative to `tmp` rather than the unmodified base. This yields `b + λ(f1-b) + λ(f2-b) - λ²(f1-b)`, which differs from the required formula by `λ²(f1-b)` wherever ft1 changed the tensor. That violates Required result step 2 (`out[X] = base[X] + λ(ft1[X]-base[X]) + λ(ft2[X]-base[X])`) and the ordering hazard called out in the Objective, and would exceed the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance on the merged tensors.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
